initialExam.title: Navy Agniveer MR 2026 (Matric Recruit)
initialExam.description: Indian Navy Agniveer MR entry for Matric Recruits in roles such as chef, steward, and hygienist. Entry-level naval service under the Agnipath scheme for 10th pass candidates.
initialExam.syllabus: Science, Mathematics, English, General Knowledge. Basic level based on 10th standard.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Exam: 50 questions, 50 marks, 30 minutes. Physical Fitness Test. Medical.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Physical Fitness Test → Medical Examination → Merit → Training
initialExam.jobRole: Agniveer MR in Indian Navy as Chef, Steward, or Hygienist
initialExam.careerGrowth: Agniveer → 25% retained as regular → Leading Seaman → Petty Officer → Chief Petty Officer.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindiannavy.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Appear for exam 5. PFT and Medical
initialExam.perks: Seva Nidhi: ₹11.71 lakh, Canteen, Medical, Free accommodation and rations
